site_name: Nile Lodge Queens WalkEalingW5 1TJ
description: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission reference 250053VAR Dated: 15/07/2025 'Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition 2 (approved plans), condition 7 (Noise assessment) and condition 8 (Enhanced sound insulation) pursuant to planning permission reference 234841FUL dated 24/12/2024 for 'Development to provide additional hostel accommodation (Sui Generis) with retained access from Queens Walk; facilitated by three storey rear and side extensions with basement levels and courtyard; associated internal and external alterations; and provision of landscaping, car parking, refuse and cycle storage'. Variation seeks to provide amended drawings in respect of minor design amendments to internal layout, roof level, changes to fenestration, changes to lightwells, stairs and access routes, ancillary equipment, acoustics'. Variation seeks addition of four additional hostel rooms at courtyard level, in place of previously approved shared lounge; shared lounge relocated in place of previously approved locker/storage space; minor changes proposed to ancillary/plant rooms at courtyard level; changes to the fenestration to facilitate the inclusion of the new rooms; part of the drawings approved under 250053VAR, the approved Section B-B drawing (drawing reference 22061-MA-PL4-XX-DR-A-141 Rev. P11) did not accurately show the depth of the lightwell updated Section B-B drawing is submitted as part of this application for consistency
